proposals.expected_signal: If mild degree-tempered propagation reduces popularity dominance while preserving LightGCN simplicity, frozen full-sort NDCG@10 should show a measurable lift over a plain uniform-sampling pairwise run
proposals.failure_mode: Tempering may underuse strong hubs and weaken collaborative signal, yielding flat or slightly worse NDCG@10 with ambiguous attribution versus ordinary propagation depth effects
proposals.hypothesis: A light graph model with propagation adjusted to damp high-degree node influence can expose a better accuracy-calibration point than standard uniform neighborhood mixing on ML-1M under the fixed evaluation protocol
